title: No charges recommended against Mountie involved in 2010 shooting
article: No criminal charges have been recommended against an RCMP officer involved in a shooting that claimed the life of one man over a year ago.
On January 9, 2010 Matthew Wilcox was shot and killed by a member of the North Vancouver RCMP after a police chase in Deep Cove.
It is alleged Wilcox was driving erratically, striking several other vehicles. He was shot after refusing to comply with the officer's orders.
The independent investigation conducted by the Vancouver Police Department has concluded the RCMP constable involved was in the 'lawful execution' of his duty.
The final report was submitted to the B.C. Coroner's Service and the RCMP, who will, at the conclusion of their review, submit it to the RCMP's Commission for Public Complaints.
